data.title: Speeding fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) – 98.50 EUR
data.summary: Stadt Musterau's Bußgeldstelle (Aktenzeichen BG-2026-114502) fined Jonas Mustermann 98.50 EUR total for speeding 23 km/h over the limit on 02.09.2026 near Musterau, plus 1 point in the Fahreignungsregister. The notice was delivered via Postzustellungsurkunde on 17.09.2026, starting a two-week objection (Einspruch) period.
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) from the city's traffic enforcement office for speeding. It became legally delivered on the date shown on the delivery certificate (Zustellungsurkunde). If you agree with the fine, no action is needed beyond paying the 98.50 EUR after the notice becomes final, quoting the Aktenzeichen. If you disagree, you must file a written objection (Einspruch) with Stadt Musterau – Bußgeldstelle by the deadline shown — note this is calculated from your actual delivery date, not today. If you miss it, the fine becomes final and enforceable, and enforcement measures may follow for non-payment. Since money and a short legal deadline are involved, consider reviewing the measurement evidence or consulting a traffic-law specialist (Anwalt für Verkehrsrecht) quickly if you plan to object.
